findings.title: [P2] Preserve empty trimmed names
findings.body: For `{ name: "" }` or `{ name: "   " }`, this now returns `"Anonymous"` instead of the previous `""`. Because the PR states that existing contracts should be preserved, retain the nullish fallback unless this boundary behavior is intentionally being changed.

findings.title: [P2] Preserve empty trimmed names instead of treating them as absent
findings.body:
For valid inputs such as `{ name: "" }` or `{ name: "   " }`, the exported API previously returned `""` after trimming because the fallback applied only to nullish values. Using `||` now returns `"Anonymous"`, breaking the existing output contract for these boundary inputs.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
